description: What a company looks like, read off its own website and written once to brand/brand.json: colours with their role, typefaces, logo and the measured contrast, plus the gaps only the client can close
client_copy: Arma el kit de marca de tu empresa —colores, tipografías y logo— leyéndolo de tu propia web.
_comment: IT DEPENDS ON artifact BECAUSE STEP 2 PIPES INTO IT: `render_kit.py |
asking about it is the step, not a nicety -- «Un kit que nadie miró no es una
fuente de verdad, es una suposición prolija» -- and without the artifact there
AND ON approval BECAUSE THE SKILL SENDS ONE: «Cambiar un color de marca es una
decisión de la clienta: va como pedido de aprobación», which is what the skill
does instead of fixing a failing contrast pair on its own.
NO TOOLSET FOR THE SCAN. `scan_site.py` downloads the site with urllib from
the terminal and not through the web toolset, so it works the same on an agent
with search turned off (capabilities/catalog.json says so under social-package).
What it needs is outbound network from the container, which is the harness's
